name: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited
summary: Bonfiglioli Transmissions Limited provides mechanical and electro-mechanical power transmissions and industrial drive solutions in India, the United States, Italy, Germany, China, and internationally. It offers industrial gearmotors, including right-angle gear and in-line geared units, and parallel shaft gearmotors; electric motors, such as synchronous, asynchronous, and synchronous reluctance motors; wheel, and travel and track drives; and transit mixer drives. The company also provides planetary geared, right-angle gearmotors and geared, and parallel shaft gearmotors and geared units; inverters and servo drives; yaw and pitch, and slew drives; precision planetary gearboxes and gearmotors; …
